# Passing Classic Levels

Clearing classic levels can be very difficult. Here is a guide to help you passing all 8000 classic levels

### General Tips
- Set the reinforcement flag in the middle of enemy army to keep the enemy troops distracted
- Passing classic levels is easier if there is some lag. Go to **Settings** and turn on __FX__ and __60 FPS__ to create lag.
- Use **Davison** as your hero. Davison appears in Wheel of Fortune once every 8 weeks. You need around 21K gem to do 200 spins. If you do not have Davison, you can use **Vlad III**.

If you are stuck on a level, try the following:
- Switch Davison's skill auto-cast between __OFF__ and __AUTO__
- Switch level mode between __Normal__ mode and __Hard__ mode
- Keep trying and wait for favorable RNG

### Recommended Troops

- **Melee**: __Undead Soldier__, __Magic Apprentice__, Ghost Assassins, Paladin, Cactuses, __Goblikazes__, __Peltasts__, __Flash Angels__
- **Ranged**: Catapult, __Ballista__, __Ice Mage__, __Fire Mage__, Scholar, __Priest Mage__, Archers, __Taurus Witchers__, __Frost Archers__
-  **Support**: __Magnetic Pioneer__, __Candle Warrior__

### Troop Recruitment

- When you are active, do as many Epic troops summon as you can at **Card Summon**. When you go offline, do Legendary troops summon. Put __Priest Mage__ in your Card Summon wishlist.
- Focus on 30x **normal recruitment** so you can fill your formation with level-7 and level-8 common/rare troops
- Do high-level Troop Card recruitment on the battlefield sparingly
